test_title: PYST 45: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 30 Sept, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A sum invested at 5% simple interest per annum grows to ₹806 in 6 years. If the amount remains the same, how much will it grow at a 12% simple interest rate in 5 years?
solution:
**Given:**

Amount (A) = ₹806

Simple Interest Rate (R1) = 5% per annum

Time (T1) = 6 years

New Simple Interest Rate (R2) = 12% per annum

New Time (T2) = 5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest Formula: A = P + SI, where SI = (P times R times T)/(100)

**Calculations:**

A = P + (P times R1 times T1)/(100)

⇒ 806 = P + (P times 5 times 6)/(100)

⇒ <sp
